::: {.callout-note}
This page renders the repository file
[`standard_draft.md`](https://github.com/ben-domingue/eco/blob/main/standard_draft.md),
which is the authoritative copy. Section numbers are the file's own. The
[round-trip report](https://github.com/ben-domingue/eco/blob/main/roundtrip_report.md)
records what the Phase 2 tests changed in it.
:::

```{r}
#| label: body
#| output: asis
body <- readLines("../standard_draft.md", warn = FALSE)
body <- body[-(1:which(grepl("^# ", body))[1])]   # drop the file's H1; the page has a title
cat(body, sep = "\n")
```
